title: Parameter Reference
summary: Official Derivative reference for one-way parameter references, covering source and reference parameters, right-click Yank/Put workflows, Python expressions, and how references differ from wires, exports, and binding.
guidance: Use this article when a one-way expression relationship is preferable to a CHOP export or bidirectional bind.
A parameter reference is created by putting an expression in the reference parameter that points at the source parameter.
Right-click Yank Parameter and Put Yanked References workflows create expression-style links that should be represented as references in planning notes.
Generated expressions should account for missing source operators when project state is dynamic, because the reference parameter evaluates the expression at runtime.
Do not confuse parameter references with same-family wires; references are dashed links across operator families and parameter expressions.
